question: Consider the sequence: $a_1=101,a_2=10101,a_3=1010101,$ and so on. Then $a_k$ is a composite number (that is, not a prime number)

options.A: if and only if $k\ge2$ and it divides $10^{k+1}+1$
options.B: if and only if $k\ge2$ and it divides $10^{k+1}-1$
options.C: if and only if $k\ge2$ and $k-2$ is divisible by 3
options.D: if and only if $k\ge2$ and $k$ is even.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
